source.schemas_from: https://personalagentprotocol.org/kit/company/schemas/{name}, byte-identical to kit/company/schemas/{name} in https://github.com/personal-agent-protocol/personal-agent-protocol at commit 9af9904f19f75f11d0e6352fbf27b42791e18ebe
source.examples_from: https://personalagentprotocol.org/docs/0.4/spec.md (sha256 b65e9620fd777a214e73e923f8e17691be390fcc07c5dd4e21c3707c8468a967), each JSON code block as published, keyed by section and its place in that section. The 5.2 Session JWT block is a header and a payload separated by a line holding ".", stored here as {header, payload}.
source.note: Copied as published; nothing edited. The project checks every JSON example in the spec against these schemas in its own build (lib/kit/examples.ts).

delegation.schema.json.title: Delegation
delegation.schema.json.description: A delegation as its decoded JWT header and payload: signed with ES256 or PS384 by a key in the Personal Agent's jwks_uri, it vouches for the delegated key in cnf.jwk (RFC 7800), which signs the Personal Agent's Session JWTs. Spec section 5.2 (Delegated keys). exp is at most 24 hours after iat. A delegation names no User, Agent ID, or Company. The header and payload are also available on their own as delegation.schema.json#/$defs/header and #/$defs/payload. The Session JWT that carries a delegation in poppy_dlg is session-jwt.schema.json.

session-jwt.schema.json.title: Session JWT
session-jwt.schema.json.description: The JWT in the Poppy-Session header, as its decoded header and payload (spec 5.2). The Personal Agent signs one for each request with a delegated key: kid is the delegated key's JWK thumbprint, and poppy_dlg is the delegation that vouches for it (delegation.schema.json). The Company verifies it as spec 5.3 describes. agent_id is optional, and ath is present only when the request carries an access token. The header and payload are also available on their own as session-jwt.schema.json#/$defs/header and #/$defs/payload.
